metadata.scope: original MATPOWER case300 and declared interventions only; all600, R300-base and RATE80-300 PGLib rows excluded
metadata.execution: read-only extraction of compact historical evidence; no inference, OPF/PF or physics recomputation
metadata.duplicate_policy: Keep every experiment/scenario record; group identical input bytes by saved SHA256. Physically equivalent renumber/reorder controls have different byte hashes and are labelled, not independent grids.
metadata.unavailable_policy: Null/blank means unavailable or not applicable, never zero. 11C compact data lack distribution/count/clipping fields.17 compact data lack material clipping magnitudes. Raw signed per-bus/per-branch details largely absent.
